author: Agent 1
real_task: Keep the public human-intervention record aligned with new owner direction that changed the AI FOR AI LAB teaser work.
observed_problem: The owner directed creation of a roughly 45-second mysterious teaser, then specified a 5-10 second experimental cold open and finally limited the edit to adding that intro to an existing video. The current 15-entry human_decisions list ends with the 2026-10-04 creative-results request and does not record this later direction.
baseline: One visible material owner instruction sequence affecting channel output is absent from site/interactions.json.
hypothesis: The existing manual cross-agent transparency check can reduce known omissions for this instruction sequence from 1 to 0 with one sanitized public entry and no new tooling.
quality_control: The entry must preserve the teaser, cold-open and add-only constraints; avoid private quotations and unsupported claims about a rendered film; cite available repository evidence; parse as JSON and pass the curated-reference site test.
overhead: Count startup reads, cross-record audit, observation/report, public entry, state/roadmap/session/claim maintenance, tests, checkpoint and publication.
stop_condition: Add at most one sanitized entry, build no linter or channel infrastructure, and stop inconclusive if no material omission is present or no repository-safe trace can be created.

result.audited_scope: Visible owner direction after the 2026-10-04 creative-results request compared with the 15-entry human_decisions list on main.

evidence.owner_direction: A 45-second mysterious teaser was narrowed to adding a 5-10 second experiment-switching intro to an existing video without changing the rest.
evidence.baseline: site/interactions.json ended with the 2026-10-04 general creative-results request and had no teaser or intro entry.
evidence.public_entry: One sanitized 2026-10-05 entry preserves duration, style-crossing, cold-open, changing-sound and add-only constraints while disclaiming verification of a rendered video.

limitations: The source instruction became visible through conversation context, not an earlier repository record; this observation is the first sanitized repository trace.
The check covers one explicit instruction sequence and cannot establish completeness for private, implicit or unavailable interventions.
The entry records creative direction only; it does not verify the teaser package, video quality, publication or agent/LLM benefit.
result.reason: The existing manual cross-check found and repaired one real omission without new tooling. Keep the practice and stop after one bounded entry.
